propositions: reconcile_check.py currently performs vendor-shape comparison using direct by-path loads of vendor-specific modules (outbound_fields.py, adf.py) and raw value matching, violating the backend-neutral core principle

The canonical differ machinery (InboundMapper/OutboundMapper from the prerequisite story) must be reused to canonicalize snapshot entries before comparison, replacing _assignee_matches, _extract_jira_field, and adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit calls

AC1 gate enforcement requires both AST-import detection (reconcile_check.py added to the core modules tuple) and source-text detection (no 'adapters/jira/' path literals) to catch by-path loads that import detection alone cannot catch
Description comparison must mirror the canonical differ's parity rule (rstrip tolerance, ADF-fit via OutboundMapper, no warning) rather than using sanitize_description which is send-path only

Annotation-label precedence (rebar-status:blocked/cancelled) causes one intended correctness difference where canonical comparison yields annotation-label-mapped status instead of raw Jira workflow status
